description: Hydrologic Modelling of Connectivity Expert Panel Recommendations 2025–Scenario 4–Connectivity EWA–Dam Inflow Trigger is a dataset listed in NSW Government open data portal (data.nsw.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by NSW Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water. The Panel recommended that the Gwydir, Namoi and NSW Border Rivers regulated water sharing plans should include a ‘connectivity’ environmental water allowance (EWA) to provide pulses as needed for water quality and other environmental outcomes during dry times. Replenishment releases triggered by the dam inflows falling below the 75th percentile on average over 30 days. Coverage: New South Wales. The portal files it under the publisher NSW Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water. Its tags are Analytics, Connectivity, DCCEEW - Water, DCCEEW - Water Analytics, Modelling. It offers 4 resource(s) in pdf, xlsx. The portal shows 2026-02-01 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-nsw.
